title: NGM: A Plug-and-Play Training-Free Memory Module for LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2605.16893v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent studies have introduced memory-augmented architectures that decouple knowledge storage from neural computation, enabling more direct access to stored representations. However, existing approaches often rely on learned memory embeddings or explicit memory and retrieval components, requiring additional training or increasing architectural complexity. To address these limitations, we propose N-gram Memory (NGM), a training-free, plug-and-play module that repurposes a backbone model's pretrained token embedding space as memory. NGM consists of a Causal N-Gram Encoder and a Cosine-Gated Memory Injector. translated_title: NGM：一种面向大语言模型的即插即用免训练记忆模块
translated_abstract: 近期的研究提出了将知识存储与神经计算解耦的记忆增强架构，使模型能够更直接地访问存储的表示。然而，现有方法通常依赖学习得到的记忆嵌入或显式的记忆与检索组件，需要额外的训练或增加架构复杂度。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了N-gram Memory（NGM），这是一种免训练、即插即用的模块，它将骨干模型预训练的词元嵌入空间重新用作记忆。NGM由一个因果N-gram编码器和一个余弦门控记忆注入器组成。前者通过直接聚合预训练的词元嵌入来构建N-gram表示，后者利用余弦相似度结合ReLU门控，自适应地控制注入到上下文表示中的检索记忆量。与传统的记忆增强架构不同，NGM既不需要额外的（训练）……
tldr: 该论文提出NGM，一种免训练、即插即用的记忆模块，通过将大语言模型预训练的词元嵌入空间重新用作记忆，并结合因果N-gram编码器与余弦门控记忆注入器，无需额外训练即可自适应地向上下文表示中注入N-gram记忆信息。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes NGM, a training-free, plug-and-play memory module that repurposes a backbone LLM's pretrained token embedding space as memory, combining a causal N-gram encoder with a cosine-gated memory injector to adaptively inject N-gram memory into contextual representations without any additional training.
